No. 1907/25 – WEDNESDAY, MARCH 25, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Below mentioned lands in total extent of about 0.5129 Hectare, Preliminary Plan No. B. 663, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Survey of Badulla District on behalf of Survey General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of Beragala (157-B) in the villages of Haldummulla (in Part) and Kirawanagama (in Part) in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Haldummulla in Badulla District in the Uva Province.
